answer: Admit newcomers only through a velvet gate: each applicant must be vouched by a kernel of three unrelated long-tenured peers, and its first earnings, called nectar, stay escrowed for a full epoch. A kernel may vouch for only one newcomer per epoch, so a factory cannot reuse one trusted core for many shells. If two applicants share a kernel member, both bonds merge into one standing and every linked bond is slashed by the merged count: one agent risks one bond, while N clones stake N bonds for one share and forfeit roughly N squared when exposed.
